title: The Power of Stories: Narrative Priming Shapes How LLM Agents Collaborate and Compete
reasoning: The paper investigates how narrative priming (storytelling) affects the collaborative behavior of LLM agents using game theory (public goods game). While the study utilizes stories with moral themes and communal values and includes an ethical considerations section, its primary focus is on social dynamics, behavioral priming, and AI alignment rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or specific ethical frameworks.
